Game Options fix for game 1.129.39.1030

Close the game before replacing packages. TS4_Access_UI.package goes in Mods/TS4_Access. With UI Cheats, TS4_Access_Compatibility_UICheats.package goes in the existing higher-priority Mods/_Overrides folder. Keep your current script and settings. Back up the previous UI pair first and clear localthumbcache.package after replacement.

In Gameplay, Enter on Auto Age (Played Households) should open the native choices; arrows and Enter select a value. Enter or Space on Auto Age (Unplayed Households) should toggle and read its state. Use Apply Changes to save. Check a Pack Settings checkbox and an Audio/Graphics control as well. Close Options and verify scanner Enter still opens an object's menu.

To roll back, close the game and restore the backed-up UI pair.
